title: Peninsular War (1808–1814)
key_facts: Conflict between Napoleonic France and British/Portuguese/Spanish forces in the Iberian Peninsula
Guerilla warfare, sieges, and the Battle of Bailén
British intervention under Wellington; French defeat and eventual withdrawal from Spain
causes: French occupation of Spain and resistance to Napoleonic reforms
British strategic concern over French control of Iberia
Spanish popular uprisings and guerrilla tactics
outcome: French defeat and withdrawal from Spain
impacts: Contributed to eventual South American independence movements
Demonstrated limits of French power in Iberia
